title: Best AI Tools for Travel Planning in 2026: Mindtrip vs Layla vs Wonderplan
description: Mindtrip, Layla, Wonderplan, and Roam Around lead 2026 AI travel planning. We compare features, business models, and best-fit use cases for every traveler type.
short_desc: Mindtrip, Layla, Wonderplan, Roam Around compared. Real 2026 pricing and features.
tldr_pick: Mindtrip is the best all-around AI travel planner in 2026 — chat-based with shared itineraries, map integration, and a clean free tier. Layla is the right pick for WhatsApp-first travelers. Wonderplan wins for backpackers who want detailed hour-by-hour itineraries. Roam Around is the mobile-first choice.
key_takeaways: Mindtrip leads the dedicated AI travel planner category with save-and-share itineraries
Layla (formerly BeautifulTrip) is the best multi-channel option with WhatsApp and iOS
Wonderplan generates the most detailed multi-day itineraries for backpackers
Roam Around is mobile-first and great for city-by-city curation
who_for: Anyone planning a trip — solo travelers, couples, families, group trips. Especially relevant for multi-city itineraries, group collaboration, and travelers who want to plan in WhatsApp or on mobile.
methodology: We aggregated 2026 reviews from youngju.dev, product reviews on G2 and Product Hunt, and direct vendor documentation. We compared the leading dedicated AI travel planners on itinerary detail, collaboration features, multi-channel support, and free vs paid tier usefulness. Not a hands-on benchmark — try the free tiers before committing.

headings.text: The AI travel planners we recommend

faq.q: What is the best AI travel planner in 2026?
faq.a: For most travelers, Mindtrip is the best all-around AI travel planner in 2026 — chat-based planning with shared itineraries, map integration, and OTA commissions baked in. For WhatsApp-first travelers, Layla (formerly BeautifulTrip) is the right pick. For backpackers who want detailed hour-by-hour itineraries, Wonderplan is the strongest free option. For mobile-first city-by-city curation, Roam Around is the choice.

Most dedicated AI travel planners offer generous free tiers in 2026. Mindtrip is free with optional premium features. Layla offers a free tier with commission-based monetization. Wonderplan has a generous free tier with ads. Roam Around is free with ads and optional commission booking. For business travelers who want auto-parsed itineraries from email, TripIt remains the standard (free with Pro at $49/year).

faq.q: Can AI travel planners book flights and hotels?
faq.a: Yes — most dedicated AI travel planners in 2026 integrate with OTAs (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda) and can book directly. Mindtrip and Layla have the deepest booking integrations. Wonderplan focuses on itinerary detail rather than booking. Roam Around and GuideGeek lean toward instant recommendations rather than end-to-end booking.

faq.q: Should I use a dedicated AI travel planner or ChatGPT?
faq.a: For a one-off question like 'plan me a 5-night itinerary in Bali', ChatGPT or Gemini will give you a usable draft in 30 seconds. For ongoing trip planning with shareable itineraries, map integration, booking, and group collaboration, a dedicated AI travel planner like Mindtrip is the better tool. The dedicated tools also remember your preferences across trips.

faq.q: Do AI travel planners work for group trips?
faq.a: Mindtrip has the best group collaboration features in 2026 — shared itineraries where friends can edit the same plan. Wonderplan and Layla offer limited sharing. Roam Around is single-user focused. For complex group trips with multiple stakeholders, Mindtrip is the right shape.
